group.label: Catalog Storefront Document Store
group.comment: The document store keeps a ready-made copy of every product and category, so the storefront loads them much faster and without load on the database. Part of the GraphCommerce_CatalogStorefront modules.

field.label: Enable Storefront Indexing
field.comment: Keeps the copy up to date as the catalog changes. After a period with this off, a full reindex of the catalog feeds brings the copy up to date again.

field.label: Serve GraphQL From Documents
field.comment: The storefront API reads products and categories from the copy. A product that is not in the copy yet is read from the database.

field.label: Record Search Terms
field.comment: Magento saves every search term and how often it is used. Off keeps the database free of this work on each search, but the search terms report and the search suggestions no longer update.
